response.query: How will the statistical plan address clustering (patients within units/providers), time-varying confounders, seasonality, multiple testing correction, model diagnostics, and which pre-specified subgroups will be tested?
response.answer: The statistical plan will use mixed-effects models to address clustering, employ time-varying confounders and seasonality adjustments, apply multiple testing corrections, and conduct model diagnostics. Pre-specified subgroups will be tested for differential effects.
